_comment: Presentation data for the plugins catalogue on site/index.html, merged with plugins.json by scripts/generate-plugin-pages.mjs. Keyed by lowercase plugin name. hl is the one-line description shown on the card.

monolith.hl: Morphing single oscillator plus sub and noise, a 12 dB SVF filter, mono or 10-voice poly, with A/B, undo/redo and MIDI Learn.

caldera.hl: Up to four filters with eleven styles, bell, shelf and notch shapes, per-filter drive and delay, 4× oversampling and 50 drag-and-drop modulation slots.
caldera.midi: Key tracking, triggered envelopes, MIDI Learn

obsidian.hl: Four oscillators, four filters, built-in effects, an arpeggiator, up to 64 voices and 100 drag-and-drop modulation slots.

strata.hl: Stereo delay with tape or stretch mode, 15 extra taps per line, six loop filters, lo-fi, diffuse, ducking and pitch-shift effects, freeze and 50 modulation slots.
strata.midi: Key tracking, triggered envelopes, MIDI Learn

basalt.hl: Caldera stripped down for performance: big controls, a large drag display, Link Filters, undo/redo, hover tips and built-in help.

gneiss.hl: 14 styles plus upward compression, ratio to Inf:1, optional lookahead, up to 32× oversampling, a 6-band sidechain EQ, MIDI triggering and loudness metering.

mica.hl: Up to 24 bands in ten shapes, slopes to 96 dB/oct, zero-latency, natural or linear phase, dynamic and spectral EQ, EQ Match and a spectrum analyser.

flint.hl: Monolith's 12 dB filter as a light low/high pass with input drive, self-oscillation and a ±6-octave envelope follower.

granite.hl: Eight styles, true-peak limiting, up to 32× oversampling, look-ahead, external sidechain, dither and EBU R128 loudness metering.

slate.hl: Gate, expander and ducker with six styles, up to 100:1 and 80 dB range, lookahead, mid/side, sidechain filters and MIDI triggering.

magma.hl: Up to six bands with 28 tube, tape, amp, saturation and FX styles, linear-phase crossovers and 50 drag-and-drop modulation slots with XLFOs, envelopes and XY pads.
magma.midi: Velocity, key, wheel and aftertouch as modulation sources

talc.hl: Single-vocal or allround detection, wide-band or linear-phase split-band, sidechain filters over a live spectrum and up to 15 ms look-ahead.

schist.hl: Up to six freely placed bands that compress or expand, up or down, to Inf:1 for limiting and gating, with dynamic, linear or minimum phase.

geode.hl: Modern, Vintage and Plate algorithms, a stepless space control, decay rate and post EQs, ducking, freeze and impulse response import, at zero latency.

malachite.hl: A squelchy resonant filter with accent, slide and a sub oscillator, driven by a 16-step sequencer with 64 patterns and scales that follows the host tempo.

tasks.create: Synths and instruments: a subtractive synth, a polysynth and an acid bass synth with its own sequencer.
tasks.shape: Filters and movement: resonant multi-filters, a live performance filter and a light saturating filter.
tasks.distort: Saturation and multiband distortion, from warm tape to broken.
tasks.mix: EQ, compression, gating, multiband dynamics and de-essing.
tasks.finish: Space, echo and loudness: a reverb, a tape delay and a limiter.
